title: The site comparison transports projection invertibility on its bounded-below domain
statement: Let B be a Grothendieck abelian symmetric monoidal closed coefficient category with functorial flat resolutions. Assume etale, pro-etale and comparison inverse images preserve flat objects. For p:X -> Y qcqs, etale complexes C,D such that C and C tensor^L Lp*D are bounded below, invertibility of the etale right-adjoint projection arrow at (C,D) implies invertibility of the ordinary pro-etale projection at (Lnu_X*C,Lnu_Y*D). The maps are the specified right-adjoint projection maps of the canonical derived pullback tensor comparisons.

source.place: Coefficient transport and clauses (2)--(3), canonical-map identifications.

proof.text: The exact monoidal comparison-pullback square induces the canonical derived monoidal square. The mate of this square is invertible on each of C and C tensor^L Lp*D by the qcqs bounded-below direct-image comparison. Apply the general transport theorem for right-adjoint projection maps along a compatible tensor square. Its counit calculation gives the asserted isomorphism without assuming either direct image is bounded.
